caption: A red laser dot lands on a white wall, and when it is moved onto a green plant the dot becomes hard to see.

sa.check: A red laser dot is on a white wall.
It is moved onto a green plant.
The dot becomes hard to see.
The dot stays red wherever it lands.

pc.expect: The dot is bright red on the white wall and dim on the green leaves, and stays red wherever it lands.
pc.fail: It is bright on the green leaves; or turns green; or is dim on the white wall.

pc.expect: The dot moves with the pointer and only then.
pc.fail: It drifts with the pointer still; or stays put while the pointer moves; or leaves a trail.

pc.expect: The dot is one small spot.
pc.fail: It splits; or is a large patch; or changes shape.

pc.expect: The dot lands where the pointer aims.
pc.fail: It is far from the aim; or appears with no pointer; or two dots from one pointer.

pc.expect: One pointer, one wall and one plant.
pc.fail: The plant duplicates; or the wall vanishes; or the dot becomes solid.

pc.expect: The wall and the plant stay the same.
pc.fail: The plant changes; or the wall changes colour; or the pointer changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
